cells.name: hook
cells.note: The creator's own call: open on the music. The four bars play on piano with no voice, over the engraved score, so the viewer hears the tune before any letters appear.

components.text: audio of the first four bars of the Minuet in G, transposed to C, on a plain piano, steady minuet tempo, no voice over it, full volume
components.raw: <audio of the first four bars of the Minuet in G, transposed to C, on a plain piano, steady minuet tempo, no voice over it, full volume ~8s ! #minuet-piano>

components.text: show image of the four bars engraved on one treble staff, black notes on white, 3/4 time signature, nothing highlighted
components.raw: <show image of the four bars engraved on one treble staff, black notes on white, 3/4 time signature, nothing highlighted #score-plain>

components.text: That's the opening of the Minuet in G, from Anna Magdalena Bach's notebook. Here it is in C, written as a single line of text.
components.raw: <That's the opening of the Minuet in G, from Anna Magdalena Bach's notebook. Here it is in C, written as a single line of text.>

components.text: show image of the whole ABC text on white in a large monospace font: the four header lines (tune number, meter 3/4, length 1/4, key C) above the one melody line of four bars, bar lines between them
components.raw: <show image of the whole ABC text on white in a large monospace font: the four header lines (tune number, meter 3/4, length 1/4, key C) above the one melody line of four bars, bar lines between them #abc-full>

components.text: The lines at the top set the rules. M is the meter, three beats in every bar. L is the default length, so a plain letter lasts one beat. And K is the key, C, which means no sharps or flats.
components.raw: <The lines at the top set the rules. M is the meter, three beats in every bar. L is the default length, so a plain letter lasts one beat. And K is the key, C, which means no sharps or flats.>

components.text: show image of the same ABC text with only the header lines in red and a short gray label beside each: "meter: 3 beats a bar", "a letter = 1 beat", "key: C"
components.raw: <show image of the same ABC text with only the header lines in red and a short gray label beside each: "meter: 3 beats a bar", "a letter = 1 beat", "key: C" #abc-header>

components.text: Each letter is a note. A capital C is middle C, and a lowercase c is the C one octave higher.
components.raw: <Each letter is a note. A capital C is middle C, and a lowercase c is the C one octave higher.>

components.text: show image of a treble staff with two notes, middle C on its ledger line and the C an octave up in the third space, the letters "C" and "c" in large monospace type under each
components.raw: <show image of a treble staff with two notes, middle C on its ledger line and the C an octave up in the third space, the letters "C" and "c" in large monospace type under each #pitch-c>

components.text: A slash cuts a note in half. So C slash is an eighth note, half a beat, and two of them fill the space of one plain C.
components.raw: <A slash cuts a note in half. So C slash is an eighth note, half a beat, and two of them fill the space of one plain C.>

components.text: show image of two panels side by side: "C" over a single quarter note, and "C/ C/" over two beamed eighth notes, the same width on the page, with "1 beat" under both
components.raw: <show image of two panels side by side: "C" over a single quarter note, and "C/ C/" over two beamed eighth notes, the same width on the page, with "1 beat" under both #length-slash>

cells.name: the bars
cells.note: Slow and even: one bar at a time, the bar lit up red in the score and in the text at the same moment, everything else gray.

components.text: Bar one is G for one beat, then C, D, E, F as four quick eighth notes. One beat, plus four halves, makes three.
components.raw: <Bar one is G for one beat, then C, D, E, F as four quick eighth notes. One beat, plus four halves, makes three.>

components.text: show image of the score with bar 1 in red and the rest gray, and under it the ABC line with "G C/ D/ E/ F/" in red
components.raw: <show image of the score with bar 1 in red and the rest gray, and under it the ABC line with "G C/ D/ E/ F/" in red #bar-1>

components.text: Bar two is G, C, C. Three plain letters, three beats.
components.raw: <Bar two is G, C, C. Three plain letters, three beats.>

components.text: show image of the same score and ABC line with bar 2 in red, same framing
components.raw: <show image of the same score and ABC line with bar 2 in red, same framing #bar-2>

components.text: Bar three is the same shape as bar one, a step higher: A, then F, G, A, B.
components.raw: <Bar three is the same shape as bar one, a step higher: A, then F, G, A, B.>

components.text: show image of the same score and ABC line with bar 3 in red, same framing
components.raw: <show image of the same score and ABC line with bar 3 in red, same framing #bar-3>

components.text: And bar four jumps up to the high c, then back down to C, C.
components.raw: <And bar four jumps up to the high c, then back down to C, C.>

components.text: show image of the same score and ABC line with bar 4 in red, same framing
components.raw: <show image of the same score and ABC line with bar 4 in red, same framing #bar-4>

components.text: Every bar should add up to three. If one doesn't, then a note is missing, or a bar line is in the wrong place.
components.raw: <Every bar should add up to three. If one doesn't, then a note is missing, or a bar line is in the wrong place.>

components.text: show image of the four bars written as text with a small "3" under each bar, all four in gray, checkmarks in red
components.raw: <show image of the four bars written as text with a small "3" under each bar, all four in gray, checkmarks in red #bar-sums>

cells.name: payoff
cells.note: Let the music run clean at the end, no voice over it.

components.text: That's the whole idea. Four bars of music, in about forty characters. Here it is again.
components.raw: <That's the whole idea. Four bars of music, in about forty characters. Here it is again.>

components.text: show image of the complete ABC text, the same framing as the hook
components.raw: <show image of the complete ABC text, the same framing as the hook #abc-full>

components.text: show image of the four bars engraved, nothing highlighted, the same framing as the cold open
components.raw: <show image of the four bars engraved, nothing highlighted, the same framing as the cold open #score-plain>

components.text: audio of the four bars of the Minuet on piano again, full volume, nothing spoken over it
